owner_approval.scope: Prepare a Google-only timing harness, prove isolated correctness, then one hosted Nano queue-to-close run with 1000 report rows, temporary expiring test access, synthetic OAuth/identity data and rollback/cleanup. No production behavior/writer change.

method.connection_adapter: Session-local SECURITY INVOKER SELECT adapter performs actual SET ROLE and parameterized SQL. No fabricated role/row results; source and Dataset clients keep real profile checks. Actual statement/lock timeout calls remain outside the function GUC scope. Client BEGIN/COMMIT become savepoint/release inside the caller outer rollback.
method.postgres_call_wall_includes: database execution, wire/driver response and invoker adapter; not pure SQL CPU
method.adstable_wall: outer total minus non-overlapping PostgreSQL call wall; not CPU time
method.stored_boundary_observation: Fresh in-memory Google reader module inserts only storage entry/exit clock observations; all branches/guards/SQL and the production source file stay unchanged.

access.membership: non-inheriting SET-only, no admin; existing runtime/coordinator/queue/source/Dataset roles plus owner for isolated setup
access.source_role: Absent on Nano. Use the exact existing repository NOLOGIN role definition after its unmodified prerequisite check; remove this test-installed role after the run. No modification of existing role definitions or broad table/public grants.
access.prepared_sql: Only exact lineage-hash-verified existing prepared migrations, inside outer rollback. No durable migration history or config activation.
access.first_provider_error: Stop; no retry or alternative authentication/route. Rollback/authorized cleanup and residue verification required.

failed_correctness_attempts.action: Preserve failure; expose retained test-only SQL/profile cause without modifying production error handling or permissions.
